name: mirage
text: On it. 'Engine quiet' is the app saying the engine's status heartbeat was over 30 s old. The engine itself kept scanning, and its log shows it working at 03:56. Its status publishes have gaps of 20-150 s during heavy passes. I'm now checking the engine's own settled bets and bids by type, how many similar bets pile up on one game, and which books its fair odds come from. Findings follow in a few minutes.
